title: RectTransform Deep Dive
description: Master anchors, pivot, size delta, and anchor presets for positioning UI elements.

slides.title: RectTransform – The UI Transform 📐
slides.content:
# Not the Same as Transform

Every UI element has a **RectTransform** instead of a regular Transform. It inherits from Transform but adds UI‑specific properties:
- **Anchors** – define how the element stretches relative to its parent.
- **Pivot** – the point around which rotation and scaling happen.
- **Size Delta** – width and height relative to the anchors.
- **Anchored Position** – the position relative to anchors.

These work together to create resolution‑independent layouts.

quizData.question: What component replaces Transform on UI elements?
quizData.explanation: UI GameObjects use RectTransform, which extends Transform.

slides.title: Anchors ⚓
slides.content:
# Sticking to the Parent

Anchors are represented by four little triangles in the Scene view. They determine how the element stretches when the parent resizes.

- An anchor can be a **point** (min = max), then the element maintains its anchored position.
- An anchor can be a **rectangle** (min ≠ max), then the element stretches to fill the distance between anchors.

Example: Anchor to top‑right corner → element stays in the top‑right regardless of screen size.

quizData.question: Setting anchors to a single point means the UI element's size will remain constant regardless of parent size.
quizData.explanation: If anchors are a point, size is controlled by Width/Height or Size Delta, not parent stretching.

slides.title: Anchor Presets 🎯
slides.content:
# Quick Setup

In the RectTransform component, you'll see a square with anchor presets. Click it to open a dropdown with common configurations:
- Top‑left, top‑center, top‑right
- Middle‑left, middle‑center, middle‑right
- Bottom‑left, bottom‑center, bottom‑right
- Stretch horizontally, vertically, or both

Hold **Shift** to also set the pivot position. Hold **Alt** to set both anchors and pivot to the chosen corner.

slides.title: Pivot 🔄
slides.content:
# The Rotation Point

The **Pivot** is the point around which the element rotates and scales, expressed as a fraction of the element's own size (0,0) = bottom‑left, (1,1) = top‑right.

- Pivot (0.5, 0.5) – center (default for most UI).
- Pivot (0, 0) – bottom‑left corner.

Combined with anchors, pivot determines how the element aligns.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Watch the Anchors!

When you change anchor presets, Unity automatically adjusts the RectTransform's values to keep the element visually in place. Learn to use **RectTransform → Set Native Size** for images to match original sprite size.
